workbench.hover.delay.title: Hover delay
workbench.hover.delay.description: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which the hover is shown for workbench items. Already visible items may require a refresh before reflecting this setting change.

workbench.hover.reducedDelay.title: Reduced hover delay
workbench.hover.reducedDelay.description: Controls the reduced delay in milliseconds used for showing hovers in specific contexts where faster feedback is beneficial.

editor.semanticTokenColorCustomizations.title: Semantic token color customizations
editor.semanticTokenColorCustomizations.description: Overrides semantic token colors and styles from the selected theme.

editor.tokenColorCustomizations.title: Token color customizations
editor.tokenColorCustomizations.description: Overrides editor syntax colors and font style from the selected theme.

workbench.colorTheme.title: Color theme
workbench.colorTheme.description: Selects one packaged Proctor color theme.

workbench.colorCustomizations.title: Color customizations
workbench.colorCustomizations.description: Overrides workbench colors in settings.json, globally or for a named theme.

workbench.preferHighContrast.title: Prefer high contrast
workbench.preferHighContrast.description: Uses a packaged high-contrast theme when stronger accessibility requirements apply.

window.zoomLevel.title: Interface zoom
window.zoomLevel.description: Sets bounded interface zoom as a percentage.

editor.fontSize.title: Editor font size
editor.fontSize.description: Sets the editor font size in pixels.

editor.lineHeight.title: Editor line height
editor.lineHeight.description: Sets the editor line height in pixels.

editor.tabSize.title: Tab size
editor.tabSize.description: Sets the displayed indentation width outside an Attempt.

editor.wordWrap.title: Word wrap
editor.wordWrap.description: Controls editor word wrapping outside an Attempt.

editor.lineNumbers.title: Line numbers
editor.lineNumbers.description: Controls editor line-number presentation outside an Attempt.

editor.minimap.enabled.title: Minimap
editor.minimap.enabled.description: Shows the editor minimap outside an Attempt.

accessibility.announcementMode.title: Announcements
accessibility.announcementMode.description: Controls the detail of assistive announcements.

workbench.tree.indent.title: Tree indentation
